verdict.rationale: Anthropic's spec and docs require every SKILL.md to include a description of what the skill does and when to use it, plus frontmatter to control whether Claude or the user triggers it (docs-17, docs-44, docs-34, docs-3) — strong documentation of intended activation. But independent hands-on reports directly contradict predictability: Vercel found skills went uninvoked in 56% of eval cases despite being documented and available, and multiple developers report triggering is 'hit or miss' even with proper YAML descriptions, sometimes needing to explicitly force the skill (comm-7, comm-8, comm-9). Missing for 10: reliable/deterministic activation matching documented triggers, first-party acknowledgment or fix for trigger unpredictability, and independent corroboration that documented 'when to use' descriptions reliably predict real invocation.
